parameters.content:
## Local candidate — deploy node package before this workflow
Install custom-nodes/n8n-nodes-patent-research into the reviewed n8n runtime. Reuse the existing USPTO Header Auth credential; do not put its value in expressions.

Caps each body as chunks arrive (10 MiB maximum), enforces a single 60-second deadline, checks actual MIME/length/signature, rejects nonpublic DNS and pins the resolved IP. Follows one exact USPTO signed redirect without the API key. Signed URLs never become node outputs. At most two in-flight originals per process; no automatic retries.

Returns the same identity-bound PDF/DOCX envelope. No normalization, corpus indexing or legal verification is implied.
